title: The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan TV Anime Casts Yui Ogura
content:
The staff for the television anime of writer Izushiro and illustrator Ruria Miyuki 's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan ( Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku ) light novel series announced on Wednesday that Yui Ogura is joining the anime's cast as Loki Leevahl, a high-ranking Magicmaster who transferred to the magical institute as Alus' partner. The anime's staff also revealed the character visual for Loki:

J-Novel Club is publishing the light novels in English and describes the story:

In a world where the Fiends run rampant... Magicmaster Alus Reigin, the young prodigy that has defeated more Fiends and reclaimed more of humanity's lost territory than anyone else alive, requests retirement from military service at age 16. But due to the twists and turns of fate surrounding his status as the No. 1 Magicmaster in the nation—the top Magicmaster out of more than 100,000—he ends up as a student at a special magical institute, hiding his identity and training his successors – a pair of beautiful Magicmaster girls! Not to mention continuing to defeat Fiends in secret.

The anime stars Yūto Uemura as protagonist Alus Reigin.

Yūsuke Suzuki ( This Monster Wants to Eat Me , Duel Masters Win ) is directing the anime at HOTLINE . Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Himitsu no AiPri , A Galaxy Next Door ) is in charge of series scripts, Yūki Kitajima ( The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You , Kakegurui , One Piece episode key animator) is designing the characters, and Takatoshi Hamano ( IDOLiSH7 , Chainsmoker Cat , Ishura ) is the sound director.

The anime will premiere in 2027.

To commemorate the novels' anime adaptation, a prequel manga titled Saikyō Mahōshi no Inton Keikaku Zero -Hajimari no Hishi-roku- ( The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan Zero -The Secret History of the Beginning-) is scheduled to launch this winter. Yoneshiro is again drawing the manga. The manga will depict Alus' life before he enrolled in the magic academy, and will connect to the main story.

Izushiro started publishing the novels on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2015. Hobby Japan published the 20th novel volume in December 2025.

Yoneshiro's The Greatest Magicmaster's Retirement Plan - The Alternative - manga launched in Square Enix 's Manga UP! app in 2020. The series ended with its 10th compiled book volume that shipped in January 2024. Comikey publishes the manga in English digitally.

Yoneshiro's manga is the second manga adaptation of the novels. Yū Uonuma 's first manga adaptation serialized in Hobby Japan 's website, and ran for two volumes.
author: ANN

title: Inherit the Winds TV Anime Casts Yasuyuki Kase
content:
The official website for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) announced on Wednesday that Yasuyuki Kase will play Serizawa Kamo ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first here ), the chief commander of Mibu Rōshigumi:

The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto. A solider who has lost his memories is aided by the famous Shinsengumi member Okita Sōji. Okita Sōji names this man "Tachikawa Jinsuke." Jinsuke's life begins anew amidst the Mibu soldiers.

The anime will star ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first ):

• Daisuke Sakuma (Snow Man member) as Tachikawa Jinsuke

• Yūki Kaji as Okita Sōji

• Aoi Yūki as Koganei Hyōgo

• Kōki Uchiyama as Hijikata Toshizō

• Yūichi Nakamura as Kondō Isami

• Nichika Ōmori as Kurosuke

• Ryōhei Kimura as Nagakura Shinpachi

• Ayumu Murase as Tōdō Heisuke

• Simba Tsuchiya as Harada Sanosuke

• Takeo Ōtsuka as Yamanaka Keisuke

Yutaka Narui and Aniplex are in charge of the original story with cooperation by Azuki Mashiba . Tomohiro Kawamura is directing the anime at Live2D Creative Studio and Drive Inc. Narui is also writing the scripts. Fumi Ebina is the character designer, and Shigeru Kishida is composing the music.

The anime will premiere in January 2027 on the "Agaru Anime" programming block on CBC , TBS , and 26 other affiliated networks. There will be an early theatrical preview screening in 2026.

The anime's four-panel manga adaptation launches on Star Seas Company 's Twi4 (read as Tsuiyon) X (formerly Twitter ) account in 2026. Matsuri Muramatsu draws the manga.

Narui is a playwright and founder of the theatrical troupe Caramel Box who has previously worked on many stage plays themed on the Shinsengumi. While one of the plays was also titled Kaze wo Tsugumono , the way the title is written is different (with "mono" being written in kanji for the play and in hiragana for the anime), and the anime is still listed as being an "original" TV anime.
author: ANN

title: 'Kaze wo Tsugumono' Announces Additional Cast
content:
The official website for the Kaze wo Tsugumono ( Inherit the Winds ) original television anime announced additional cast members on Wednesday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027 at 11:30 p.m. on the Agaru Anime programming block on CBC and TBS' 28 affiliated stations.

Cast Shinpachi Nagakura: Ryouhei Kimura ( Grand Blue ) Heisuke Toudou: Ayumu Murase ( Chainsaw Man ) Sanosuke Harada: Simba Tsuchiya ( Burn the Witch ) Keisuke Yamanami: Takeo Ootsuka ( Otome Game Sekai wa Mob ni Kibishii Sekai desu ) Kamo Serizawa: Yasuyuki Kase ( [Oshi no Ko] )

Tomohiro Kawamura ( Neko Neko Nihonshi ) is directing the anime at Drive and Live2D Creative Studio . Azuki Mashiba is providing original work cooperation. Fumi Ebina is designing the characters, while Shigeru Kishida ( Rilakkuma to Yuuenchi ) is composing the music.

Playwright Yutaka Narui , founder of the theater troupe Caramel Box and known for the Tachikawa Jinsuke stage play series including the Shinsengumi-themed Kaze wo Tsugumono , is penning the script for the anime. Narui is also co-credited for the original work with Aniplex .

News Submitted by NokkiMal

title: Blue Box Anime's Season 2 Trailer Unveils Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the anime of Kōji Miura 's Blue Box ( Ao no Hako ) manga unveiled the main promotional video and main visual for the anime's second season on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the anime's opening theme song "Anata no Hana no Iro" (The Color of Your Flower) by singer-songwriter aiko , and the ending theme song "blue in" by the duo elsewhere kikou .

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service publishes the manga in English digitally, and describes the story:

Taiki Inomata is on the boys' badminton team at sports powerhouse Eimei Junior and Senior High. He's in love with basketball player Chinatsu Kano, the older girl he trains alongside every morning in the gym. One Spring day, their relationship takes a sharp turn ... And thus begins this brand-new series of love, sports and youth!

Yoshino Aoyama joins the cast in the new season as Yumeka Kido.

Daisuke Sakō ( Lupin Zero ) is taking over as director for the anime from first season director Yūichirō Yano . Electric Circus also takes over as the animation studio from Telecom Animation Film . Anri Ishii takes over from Ōnoo Fujii as art director. Yumika Okazaki takes over from Yoshihiro Kasahara as editor. The rest of the main staff retain their roles from the first season.

The season will premiere on TBS and 27 other channels on October 4, and will also begin streaming on Netflix in October.

The anime stars:

• Shōya Chiba as Taiki Inomata

• Reina Ueda as Chinatsu Kano

• Akari Kitō as Hina Chono

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Kyo Kasahara

• Yūma Uchida as Kengo Haryū

• Shōgo Sakata as Ryōsuke Nishida

• Anna Nagase as Nagisa Funami

• Asaki Yuikawa as Niina Shimazaki

• Yūki Ono as Shōta Hyōdō

• Kenshō Ono as Shūji Yusa

• Kana Ichinose as Ayame Moriya

• Yūki Kaji as Kazuma Matsuoka

Yūichirō Yano ( Moyashimon , Lupin the Third: Part 5 ) directed the first season, and Yūko Kakihara ( Buddy Daddies , Cells at Work! , Chihayafuru seasons 2-3) oversaw the series scripts. Miho Tanino ( Tower of God , Blue Thermal ) designed the characters. Telecom Animation Film produced the animation, and UNLIMITED PRODUCE by TMS was in charge of planning and production.

The anime's first season debuted on television in Japan in October 2024 on TBS and 28 affiliated networks. The anime streamed weekly on Netflix . The first season aired for two consecutive cours (quarters of a year). The second cours premiered on Japanese television in January 2025.

Miura first published the story as a one-shot manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in 2020. The magazine started the manga's serialization in April 2021. The manga ended on July 13. Shueisha published the manga's 26th volume on July 3. The 27th volume will ship on October 2 and the 28th and final volume will ship on December 4. Viz Media published the manga's 21st volume on August 4. The manga has more than 6.2 million copies in circulation.

title: Blue Box Season 2 Reveals Main Visual, Trailer, Theme Songs
content:
The upcoming Blue Box Season 2 revealed a main visual and trailer, along with the opening and ending theme songs on Wednesday. Singer aiko is performing “Anata no Hana no Iro” for the opening theme song, while the band elsewhere kikou sings “blue in” for the ending theme song. The sequel is slated to premiere on October 4, 2026.

Both theme songs are featured in the latest trailer:

Studio Electric Circus is animating the second season, replacing Telecom Animation Film. Daisuke Sato is the new director, taking over from Yuichiro Yano. The returning staff includes Yuko Kakihara as the one handling the series composition, Miho Tanino as character designer, and features music by Takashi Omama.

• Shoya Chiba as Taiki Inomata

• Reina Ueda as Chinatsu Kano

• Akari Kito as Hina Chono

• Chiaki Kobayashi as Kyo Kasahara

• Kana Ichinose as Ayame Moriya

• Yuma Uchida as Kengo Hanyu

Koji Miura writes and draws the manga for Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine. The manga began serialization in April 2021 and has 24 published volumes as of February 2026. He’s in love with basketball player Chinatsu Kano, the older girl he trains alongside every morning in the gym. title: Red River's Chie Shinohara Launches New Historical Manga on September 24
content:
The October issue of Shogakukan 's Cheese! magazine announced on Monday that manga creator Chie Shinohara will launch a new manga titled Itsukinomiya Genshitan (The Records of Itsukinomiya Visions) in the magazine's next issue on September 24.

The "historical mystery epic" manga is set in Ise Province during Japan's Asuka period (538-710 CE), and centers on an imperial princess. The princess serves the gods at Ise Grand Shrine, as is the custom for unmarried princesses at the time. The story begins when someone visits her, which will lead to a great turn in the pages of history.

Shinohara serialized her classic Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga in Shogakukan 's Shōjo Comic ( Sho-Comi ) magazine from 1995 to 2002. Viz Media started releasing the manga in English in 2004, and released all 28 volumes between 2004 to 2010. The company then started re-releasing the manga in 3-in-1 omnibus editions in October 2024, and released the seventh omnibus volume on April 21.

The Red River manga inspired a stage play by the famed all-female Takarazuka Revue troupe in 2018. The manga is also inspiring an ongoing television anime that debuted on July 7. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as it airs in Japan.

title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2's New Video Previews Ending Song
content:
The official website for the second season of the anime based on Wookjakga 's A Returner's Magic Should Be Special ( Kikansha no Mahō wa Tokubetsu Desu in Japanese) Korean webtoon presented a new promotional video for the anime on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the anime's ending theme song "Everlasting" by singer-songwriter krage .

The new season will premiere in Fuji TV 's " +Ultra " programming block in October, and it will run on Wednesdays at 24:45 (effectively, Thursdays at 12:45 a.m.). The first season began re-airing on Fuji TV and Kansai TV in July.

Crunchyroll will stream the new season.

The rock band FLOW returns to create the "Sorrow" song specifically for the new season's opening theme.

The anime's cast includes:

• Takuma Terashima as Desir Herman

• Sayumi Suzushiro as Romantica Eru

• Natsumi Fujiwara as Pram Schnaizer

• Asami Seto as Azrest Kingscrown

Taishi Kawaguchi returns to direct the anime at Arvo Animation , nad Takamitsu Kouno ( She Professed Herself Pupil of the Wise Man , Absolute Duo , We Without Wings - Under the Innocent Sky ) returns to oversee and write the scripts. Hiromi Katō ( Violinist of Hamelin , Kobato. , Irina: The Vampire Cosmonaut ) is designing the characters, and Daisuke Negishi is the art director. Kenta Higashiohji ( Pole Princess!! ) returns to compose the music.

Other staff include:

• Art Design: Satoshi Fujimoto, Taiga Saitō, Takeshi Mukai, Tetsuo Imaizumi

• Prop Design: Shōtarō Hashiguchi

• Color Key Artist: Aiko Matsuyama

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hideki Imaizumi

• Editing: Gō Sadamatsu

• Sound Director: Takatoshi Hamano

• Sound Effects: Yasumasa Koyama

Yen Press is releasing the series in English and it describes the story:

In a time when the Shadow World has taken over and most of humanity is wiped out, a party of six heroes strives and fails to save the world… But magician Desir Herman is given a second chance when he opens his eyes and finds that he's gone back thirteen years in the past! It's now up to him to gather his party once more and stop the greatest catastrophe in human history!

The first season of the anime debuted in October 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the series as it aired in English-speaking, Latin America, and European countries, along with an English dub .

title: Shiro Yoshida Launches New Kemonogari Manga
content:
Manga creator Shiro Yoshida launched a new manga titled Kemonogari (Hunting Animals) manga on DeNA 's Manga Box app on Sunday.

The "panic-in-closed-village horror" manga is set in a village named Habaki, which has a strange custom that grants the head of the village supreme authority. The story centers on Akira Sasaki, the second son of the family that leads the village. In the coming new year, Akira's older brother, the eldest son Hikaru, will undergo the ceremony that will make him the next village chief. Akira decides to use the ceremony as an opportunity to ask his childhood friend and crush Kotori Karino to leave the village with him. Meanwhile, in the mountain neighboring Habaki, two men go missing. The village remains preoccupied with preparations for the ceremony. On the day of the ceremony, Hikaru takes the mask signifying his ascent as village chief, and prepares to make his speech, when a strange creature appears.

title: Ruby on the Cake: Feast of the Man-Eating Witches Manga Ends
content:
This year's ninth issue of Square Enix 's Monthly Big Gangan magazine published the final chapter of Miki Morinaga 's Ruby on the Cake: Feast of the Man-Eating Witches ( Ruby on the Cake: Hitokui Majo no Bansan-kai ) manga on Tuesday. Retailers are listing the manga's fourth volume as the final volume, which will ship on October 23.

Square Enix 's Manga UP! Global service publishes the series in English and describes the story:

Within London dwells humanoid monsters that eat only men—Witches. In order to exterminate them, the British Secret Intelligence Service MI6 formed a unit known as RED. Ruby Blood, a young genius Witch Hunter, is a member of this unit. Off duty, she's just an ordinary, fun-loving girl who loves food, her family, and most of all, her father's home-cooked dinners. But on Christmas Night, something happens that changes her fate entirely... An eat-or-be-eaten girl-led suspense!

Morinaga launched the series on Square Enix 's Manga UP! platform in April 2024. Square Enix shipped the third compiled book volume on December 25.
